import numpy as np

# Treasury bond yields from the table - parsed from page 88
# 1971 data (4th column group in the table)
yields_1971 = {
    'Jan': 5.18,
    'Feb': 5.16,
    'Mar': 5.39,
    'Apr': 5.28,

    'June': 5.23,
    'July': 5.09,
    'Aug': 5.04,
    'Sept': 5.09,
    'Oct': 5.24,
    'Nov': 5.36,
    'Dec': 5.66
}

# 1972 data (5th column group in the table)
yields_1972 = {
    'Jan': 5.74,
    'Feb': 5.86,
    'Mar': 6.05,
    'Apr': 5.84,
    'May': 5.85,
    'June': 6.05,
    'July': 6.07,
    'Aug': 6.02,
    'Sept': 6.32,
    'Oct': 6.27,
    'Nov': 6.52,
    'Dec': 6.81
}

# 1973 data (6th column group in the table) 
yields_1973 = {
    'Jan': 6.86,
    'Feb': 6.44,  # Note: has 5/ footnote (existing bond dropped)
    'Mar': 6.39,
    'Apr': 6.53,
    'May': 6.94,
    'June': 6.99,
    'July': 6.57  # This is what we need to predict
}

# Create time index: Jan 1971 = 1, Feb 1971 = 2, ..., June 1973 = 30
months = []
yields = []

# Jan 1971 (1) to Dec 1971 (12)
for i, (month, yield_val) in enumerate(yields_1971.items()):
    months.append(i + 1)
    yields.append(yield_val)

# Jan 1972 (13) to Dec 1972 (24)
for i, (month, yield_val) in enumerate(yields_1972.items()):
    months.append(i + 13)
    yields.append(yield_val)

# Jan 1973 (25) to July 1973 (31)
for i, (month, yield_val) in enumerate(yields_1973.items()):
    months.append(i + 25)
    yields.append(yield_val)

print("Month index -> Yield:")
for m, y in zip(months, yields):
    print(f"  {m:2d} -> {y}")

# We need Jan 1971 (1) to June 1973 (30) for training
X_train = np.array(months[:30])  # 1 to 30
y_train = np.array(yields[:30])   # yields for Jan 1971 to June 1973

print(f"\nTraining data: X = {X_train}")
print(f"Training yields: {y_train}")

# The actual July 1973 value (index 30, which is month 31)
actual_july_1973 = yields[30]  # This is July 1973
print(f"\nActual July 1973 yield: {actual_july_1973}")

# Fit polynomial regression of degree 2
coefficients = np.polyfit(X_train, y_train, 2)
print(f"\nPolynomial coefficients (degree 2): {coefficients}")

# Create polynomial function
poly = np.poly1d(coefficients)

# Predict for July 1973 (month index 31)
predicted_july_1973 = poly(31)
print(f"\nPredicted July 1973 yield: {predicted_july_1973}")

# Calculate absolute difference
absolute_difference = abs(predicted_july_1973 - actual_july_1973)
print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {absolute_difference}")

# Round to 3 decimal places
print(f"\nRounded to 3 decimal places: {round(absolute_difference, 3)}")
